****_Action Comics_ (Volume 2) #1**** is an issue of the series [_Action Comics_ (Volume 2)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Action_Comics_Vol_2 "Action Comics Vol 2") with a cover date of [November, 2011](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2011,_November "Category:2011, November"). It was published on September 7, 2011.

## Synopsis for "Superman Versus the City of Tomorrow"

[Superman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman_(Clark_Kent) "Superman (Clark Kent)") takes a businessman named [Glen Glenmorgan](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Glen_Glenmorgan_(Prime_Earth) "Glen Glenmorgan (Prime Earth)") hostage and threatens to throw him down from the balcony of a tall building unless the businessman confesses to his crimes. The police surround the building and threaten to shoot Superman, and in response, he simply throws both himself _and_ Glenmorgan from the balcony. Superman uses his powers to land safely with Glenmorgan in hand, for whom the experience convinces him to confess to having sabotaged the train system. Despite this, a policeman shoots at Superman, who confirms the rumours the [Daily Planet](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Daily_Planet "Daily Planet") has been spreading about him by _catching_ the bullet in his hand. He makes his escape, but not before telling Detective Blake - the officer in charge - about an ulcer he ought to get checked, having detected it with his x-ray vision.

## Appearing in "Superman Versus the City of Tomorrow"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Superman (Clark Kent)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kal-El_(Prime_Earth) "Kal-El (Prime Earth)")

## Notes

*   This run of _Action Comics_ (through [issue 18](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Action_Comics_Vol_2_18 "Action Comics Vol 2 18")) is set early in Superman's career, approximately six years prior to [_Superman_ (Volume 3) #1](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman_Vol_3_1 "Superman Vol 3 1").
*   Mrs. Nyxly mentions that three of Clark's friends stopped by. She is referring to the [Legion of Super-Heroes](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Legion_of_Super-Heroes "Legion of Super-Heroes"), who have come back in time to prevent his death.
*   The man with whom [Glen Glenmorgan](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Glen_Glenmorgan_(Prime_Earth) "Glen Glenmorgan (Prime Earth)") is making deals is [Vyndktvx](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Vyndktvx_(Prime_Earth) "Vyndktvx (Prime Earth)"), who uses Superman's attack on Glenmorgan as an opportunity to sow distrust about him.
